taskpack.goal: Complete the interrupted Phase 2 implementation contract from P2-04 through P2-07B, connect durable clean-snapshot cleanup evidence, and produce verified integration state for operator acceptance.
taskpack.integration_policy: verified recovery integration baseline followed by operator review; never merge, push, activate a candidate release, or execute P2-08

contract.changed_files_policy: current attempt Git worktree state is authoritative; only declared expected_output_artifacts may survive outside Git status
contract.cleanup_policy: seal and validate the terminal result first, remove only the disposable snapshot, then atomically publish a schema-valid cleanup receipt bound to the sealed result; projection derives effective cleanup status from the receipt
contract.promotion_policy: P2-08 remains forbidden until operator review, source integration, candidate release installation, and separate promotion-taskpack approval

write_scope_cardinality_policy.exception_scope_rule: production and schema paths exact; test and fixture directory scopes allowed

success_criteria: Every accepted task has a Git-grounded current-attempt diff or an explicit no-change result.
The complete runtime suite passes after each integrated change.
Snapshot cleanup has durable receipt evidence and never deletes a sealed result.
P2-08 is not executed and no source branch is merged or pushed.

policy.semantic_authority: source plan plus approved review v4
policy.repo_map_policy: consume the committed Phase 2 handoff as bounded context; inspect current source for changed symbols
policy.trace_policy: task-level compact evidence plus milestone integration report
policy.merge_policy: integration baseline only; operator controls source merge
policy.network_policy: no live provider calibration outside ordinary Codex worker calls

tasks.objective: Refresh the bounded Phase 2 repository handoff against the committed recovery source, naming only symbols, tests, and integration risks needed by P2-06R and P2-07B-R.
tasks.goal_alignment: Prevents L2 recovery workers from rereading the full runtime and invalidates stale source bindings from the v6 handoff.
acceptance_criteria: The handoff binds the current committed source and supersedes only stale v6 map content.
It names exact symbols and focused tests for P2-06R and P2-07B-R without a repository dump.
It includes the P2-05C cleanup receipt interfaces consumed by P2-06R.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if the handoff cannot remain bounded and evidence-linked.

tasks.objective: Audit and repair the operator action ledger so every supported operator input maps to the closed research vocabulary with append-only, replay-idempotent, secret-safe evidence.
tasks.goal_alignment: Completes the interrupted P2-04 review without trusting historical changed-file declarations.
acceptance_criteria: Manual gates, permission answers, guidance, and decisions map to the closed vocabulary.
Status inspection and deterministic controller actions do not count as interventions.
Replay is idempotent by action ID and retained reasons are bounded and secret-safe.
An existing complete implementation may return no code change only with focused verification evidence.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if a mode receives unregistered task information or operator secrets must be duplicated.

tasks.objective: Audit and repair versioned recovery snapshots, immutable all-outcome result bundles, projection rebuild, scan-scope binding, and concise comparison output.
tasks.goal_alignment: Completes P2-05 result authority before production cleanup is connected.
acceptance_criteria: All terminal outcomes remain visible and recovery snapshots cannot be mistaken for terminal bundles.
Result and sidecar publish through one fsynced staging directory and atomic no-replace publication.
Bundling validates run, protocol, taskpack, acceptance, evaluator, sandbox, scan-scope, and invocation-set bindings.
Projection rebuild preserves totals and bundle digests and comparison retains unsuccessful runs.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if a sealed bundle can mutate or SQLite becomes authority.

tasks.objective: Connect clean-snapshot cleanup to the production finalizer and publish durable cleanup evidence bound to the sealed terminal result.
tasks.goal_alignment: Closes the review finding that disposable repositories were retained and cleanup status stayed permanently pending.
acceptance_criteria: The finalizer seals and validates the terminal result before cleanup starts.
Cleanup removes only the disposable snapshot and revalidates the sealed result digest afterwards.
A schema-valid immutable receipt binds run identity, sealed result digest, pre/post digest, and removed, already_absent, or failed status.
Cleanup failure preserves the terminal result and is visible in projection, show, and comparison.
A missing receipt leaves cleanup incomplete rather than silently completed.
Fault-injection tests prove result preservation and idempotent recovery.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if cleanup must mutate the sealed result or can remove authority outside the disposable snapshot.

tasks.objective: Audit and repair the three execution-mode adapters under one immutable protocol, one provider lane, standalone sanitized workspaces, and complete lifecycle registry authority.
tasks.goal_alignment: Completes P2-06 with the cleanup-finalization dependency made explicit.
acceptance_criteria: All modes consume equal protocol facts, environment, model policy, budgets, and operator limits.
Author, attempt, and candidate workspaces use independent standalone Git object stores.
Every provider lifecycle is registered, sandbox-bound, terminal, and included exactly once in the sealed invocation manifest.
Missing, stale, extra, unconsumed, or non-terminal registrations fail before evaluation.
Every mode reaches the common evaluator, result finalizer, and P2-05C cleanup receipt path.
Ordinary tests never launch a live provider.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if modes receive unequal inputs or provider-visible state can modify controller authority.

tasks.objective: Re-run deterministic L1 and bounded L2 calibration across all modes and retain equal-input, usage, isolation, cleanup, bundle, replay, and projection evidence.
tasks.goal_alignment: Proves the repaired harness before candidate promotion.
acceptance_criteria: All three modes execute the same deterministic protocol family and environment contract.
Counted lifecycle and token usage coverage are 100 percent without duplicate stable-request cost.
Canary denial, sealed result preservation, and cleanup receipt completion are proven.
Every required terminal outcome remains visible after projection rebuild.
Calibration output makes no benchmark superiority claim.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if deterministic evidence requires a live provider or is presented as scored evidence.

tasks.objective: Audit and repair deterministic Phase 2 gate controllers and relation validators without executing promotion or any live provider call.
tasks.goal_alignment: Leaves an executable candidate for the separately approved P2-08 promotion taskpack.
acceptance_criteria: Gate validators recompute Git and evidence relations rather than trusting schema-valid strings.
P2-09 cannot call a provider without current epoch-bound operator authorization.
The candidate runtime can materialize the separately governed controller-only promotion blueprint.
This recovery run does not execute P2-08, install a candidate release, merge the source branch, or push.
The complete runtime suite passes on the final integration baseline.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if a gate can pass without recomputation or a live call can bypass current authorization.
